ns2:section.sectionText: Introductory course focusing on listening comprehension, oral skills, reading, writing, and culture. Global Online Course. This section is taught by instructors of the Illinois in Vienna Programs based in Austria and is open to all students. The course has a thematic focus on Vienna and Austria, which makes it a great option for students interested in studying abroad in Vienna or another German-speaking country, although this is not a requirement. The course meets twice a week via Zoom at the scheduled times, with additional assignments due on Friday.
